entities.summary: Lloyd Glenn McClendon is an American former professional baseball outfielder, coach and manager who currently serves as the manager for the Piratas de Campeche of the Mexican League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) as an outfielder from 1987 to 1994 for the Cincinnati Reds, Chicago Cubs, and Pittsburgh Pirates.
